decisions.reason: The requested steak reshaping and text-readability change apply to the separate grill design, not the bottle and cloud illustration.
Although both illustrations contain meat and the same slogan, the source specifically changes the steaks and text in the separate grill design and does not alter the stamped-meat design.
The source concerns steak shape and text readability in the grill illustration, not the text bubble, sky-spanning text, or place name in the Riverton design.
Changing the steak shape and text readability does not change the required hand-drawn, non-AI production method.
